== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Incom Corporation & •Koensayr Manufacturing (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text. The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-L-incomcorporation&koensayrmanufacturing-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-80-Incom_Corporation_Koensayr_Manufacturing.png]]) show the original text.

* '''Text source:''' the Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type, 2012-07-21 capture: https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html; “(Immune to Alter.)” is drawn as the icon). Icons are drawn as on the printed slips.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on a Rebel Base war room. Your ability-1 permanent pilots aboard T-47s, X-wings, Y-wings, and Z-95s (except squadrons) are replaced by ability-2 permanent pilots who add 1 to power. During your control phase, may retrieve one Y-wing or Z-95. Suspended if opponent controls this site. (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card (GEMP <code>1261_81</code>; printed frame, Decipher art, title, lore, icons and set mark as on the Players Committee card image) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
